message.content:
**Pet‑Friendly Train Station in Miami** | Station | Location | Pet Policy | Notes | |---------|----------|------------|-------| | **Miami Intermodal Center (MIA)** – the Amtrak station for the Silver Service (Silver Meteor / Silver Star) | 1st St & 1st Ave, Miami, FL 33132 | **Pets allowed on Amtrak trains** (must be in a carrier that fits under the seat or in the luggage area). The station itself is pet‑friendly: no pets are prohibited from the concourse, and there are no special pet‑only areas, but you can bring your pet in a carrier while you wait. | • The station is the main passenger rail hub in Miami.
• Amtrak’s policy: pets are permitted on board if they are in a carrier that fits under the seat or in the luggage area.
• The station has restrooms, a waiting area, and a small café.
• Contact: (305) 877‑4000 (Amtrak Customer Service). | ### How to Use the Station with a Pet 1. **Check Amtrak’s Pet Policy** – Before you travel, confirm that your pet meets Amtrak’s requirements (carrier size, health documentation, etc.). 2. **Arrive Early** – Give yourself extra time to navigate the station with your pet. 3. **Carrier** – Keep your pet in a carrier that fits under the seat or in the luggage area. 4. **Station Facilities** – While the station doesn’t have dedicated pet‑friendly amenities (like a pet wash station), the waiting area is open and you can walk your pet around the concourse if needed. ### Quick Contact - **Amtrak Customer Service (Miami)**: (305) 877‑4000 - **Website**: [Amtrak – Miami Station](https://www.amtrak.com/stations/mia) --- **Bottom line:** The Miami Intermodal Center (MIA) is the primary train station in Miami that allows pets on Amtrak trains. While the station itself doesn’t have special pet facilities, it is pet‑friendly in the sense that pets are permitted in carriers while you wait and travel. If you’re planning a trip, just make sure your pet meets Amtrak’s carrier and health requirements.
